query:
SELECT c.id as conversation_id, c.title, c.userId, c.agentId, c.createdAt as conversation_created,
       m.id as message_id, m.role, LEFT(m.content, 100) as content_preview, m.createdAt as message_created
FROM conversations c
LEFT JOIN messages m ON c.id = m.conversationId
ORDER BY c.createdAt DESC, m.createdAt ASC
LIMIT 20;
